name: ADP CLI
desc: Command line for Tencent Cloud ADP agent projects
desc_zh: 腾讯云智能体开发平台的命令行工具
solves: Publishing an ADP agent by hand means clicking through the console; one command now builds, deploys and releases it.
solves_zh: 在控制台一步步点才能发布智能体，现在一条命令就能部署并发布。
best_for: You keep agent config in a repository and want deploys to run inside an existing pipeline.
best_for_zh: 智能体配置放在仓库里，想让发布动作跑进已有的研发流水线。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1759/104191 (产品动态)）。 Date is month precision only — the official product-dynamics entry stamps it 2026-10 and no day is published. The CLI is the command-line face of 腾讯云智能体开发平台 (see tencent-adp.json): install, authenticate, then build and publish agent applications from a terminal. Docs page last updated 2026-11-04. 首次公开日期来源：https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1759/104191 首次公开日期仅精确到月。
